title: Two Sum
prompt: Given an array of integers and a target value, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target. Assume exactly one valid pair exists.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
prompt: Given a string, find the length of the longest contiguous substring that contains no repeated characters.

title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
prompt: Given a list of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return the resulting non-overlapping set, sorted by start time.

title: Design an LRU Cache
prompt: Design a data structure that supports get and put operations in O(1) time, evicting the least recently used item when it exceeds a fixed capacity.

title: Number of Islands
prompt: Given a 2D grid of '1's (land) and '0's (water), count the number of distinct islands, where an island is a group of connected land cells (horizontally or vertically).

title: Course Schedule
prompt: Given a number of courses and a list of prerequisite pairs, determine whether it's possible to finish all courses given the prerequisite constraints.

title: Word Break
prompt: Given a string and a dictionary of words, determine whether the string can be segmented into a sequence of one or more dictionary words.

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
prompt: Given two sorted arrays of possibly different sizes, find the median of the combined data set in better than O(n) time.

title: Serialize and Deserialize a Binary Tree
prompt: Design an algorithm to convert a binary tree into a string representation and reconstruct the original tree from that string.

title: Trapping Rain Water
prompt: Given an array representing elevation heights, compute how much rainwater the terrain can trap between the bars after raining.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
prompt: Given an array of integers, return the k most frequently occurring elements.

title: Minimum Meeting Rooms
prompt: Given a list of meeting time intervals, find the minimum number of conference rooms required to hold all the meetings without overlap.

title: Group Anagrams
prompt: Given an array of strings, group the strings that are anagrams of one another into separate lists.

title: Product of Array Except Self
prompt: Given an array, return a new array where each element is the product of all other elements, without using division and in O(n) time.

title: Design a Rate Limiter
prompt: Design a system that limits the number of requests a client can make within a rolling time window, discussing the trade-offs between fixed windows, sliding windows, and token buckets.

title: Copy a Linked List with a Random Pointer
prompt: Given a linked list where each node has an extra pointer that can point to any node or null, create a deep copy of the list.

title: Minimum Window Substring
prompt: Given two strings s and t, find the smallest substring of s that contains every character of t, including duplicates.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
prompt: Given an array and a window size k, return the maximum value in each sliding window as it moves across the array.

title: Validate a Binary Search Tree
prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, determine whether it is a valid binary search tree.

title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
prompt: Given the root of a binary search tree, find the kth smallest value it contains.

title: Clone a Graph
prompt: Given a reference node in a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy of the entire graph.

title: Coin Change
prompt: Given a set of coin denominations and a target amount, find the fewest number of coins needed to make that amount, or report it's impossible.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
prompt: Given an array of integers, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

title: Word Ladder
prompt: Given a start word, an end word, and a word list, find the length of the shortest transformation sequence where each step changes exactly one letter and each intermediate word is valid.

title: Alien Dictionary
prompt: Given a list of words sorted according to the rules of an unknown alien alphabet, derive a valid ordering of the letters.

title: Design a Parking Lot System
prompt: Design the classes and interfaces for a multi-level parking lot system that supports different vehicle sizes, spot allocation, and fee calculation.

title: Design a URL Shortening Service
prompt: Design a service like a URL shortener, discussing how you'd generate short codes, handle collisions, and scale reads versus writes.

title: Rotting Oranges
prompt: Given a grid where cells contain fresh oranges, rotten oranges, or are empty, find the minimum time for all fresh oranges to rot, given that rot spreads to adjacent cells each minute.

title: Task Scheduler
prompt: Given a list of tasks and a cooldown period between identical tasks, find the minimum number of time units needed to complete all tasks.

title: Find Median from a Data Stream
prompt: Design a data structure that supports adding numbers one at a time and efficiently returning the median of all numbers seen so far.

title: K Closest Points to the Origin
prompt: Given a list of points on a 2D plane, return the k points closest to the origin.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
prompt: Given an array of integers and a target k, find the total number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k.

title: Design a Simplified News Feed
prompt: Design a simplified social feed feature where users can post and follow others, and retrieve the most recent posts from people they follow, efficiently.

title: Employee Free Time
prompt: Given each employee's schedule as a list of non-overlapping intervals, find the common free time slots shared by everyone across the whole company.

title: Reorganize String
prompt: Given a string, rearrange its characters so that no two adjacent characters are the same, or determine that it's not possible.
